caption: The drawing features an object that consists of a metallic, curved, vertical rod fixed with two round fasteners at its base, extending upward and then arching horizontally before finishing in a small, flame-like blue structure at the top right. Connected to the lower portion of the rod is a horizontally oriented, irregular oval-shaped base with a silvery, metallic appearance, highlighted with blue and grey tones. On this base, there is a dark, angular shape pointing upward, appearing as if attached or resting atop the metallic base. The entire composition is rendered primarily in muted hues of blue, grey, brown, and black, with subtle color gradients indicating light and shadow. The background is plain, with a faintly sketched border frame enclosing the image, drawn on a lightly yellowed, off-white paper.
title: Lamp
